observations: A blue and grey corded electric hand drill is shown inside a black plastic carrying case.
The brand 'MAXMECH' is visible on a label on the side of the drill in photo 0.
The drill's chuck is wrapped in clear protective plastic.
The power cord is black and coiled, ending in a two-pin plug.
The upper part of the carrying case has molded slots for accessories (like drill bits), which appear to be empty.
The technical specifications and model number on the side label are blurry and illegible.

claims.claim: designed for drilling holes and driving
claims.evidence: This is the standard function of an electric hand drill.

risks.proof: A video of the drill being plugged in and running through its speed range.
A photo showing all items included in the sale, specifically filling the empty slots in the case.
A clear, legible photo of the side label showing the model number and wattage (W).
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest-spec model of this brand

proof_requests: A clear, close-up photo of the label on the side of the drill to read the model number and specifications.
A video showing the drill powered on and functioning.
Confirmation and photos of any accessories (drill bits, chuck key, side handle) included in the case.
response.reason: The brand is identified, but the specific model number and power rating are unreadable on the label. Additionally, the carrying case appears to be missing the accessories it was designed to hold.
